title: Galaxy
author: Google
desc: A galaxy made of slowly swirling stars.
pref_particle_alpha_summary: Adjust particle transparency (applies to both calculation modes)
pref_precise_calc_summary: Use M31-inspired logarithmic spiral initialization instead of the legacy random-angle model
pref_use_light2_summary: Enable to use light2; disable to use light1
pref_arm_count_summary: Number of spiral arms (effective only in precise mode)
pref_arm_offset_summary: Angular spacing between arms in radians (0 ~ 2π, precise mode only)
pref_pitch_angle_summary: Spiral pitch angle in degrees (0 ~ 30, precise mode only)
pref_inner_scatter_summary: Arm scatter strength near the core (precise mode only)
pref_outer_scatter_summary: Arm scatter strength in outer regions (precise mode only)
pref_turbulence_summary: Random turbulence intensity for precise arm deformation
pref_forbidden_radius_summary: Inner radius excluded from logarithmic arm fitting (precise mode only)
pref_ellipse_ratio_summary: Ellipticity of arm morphology (0.5 ~ 1.0, precise mode only)
pref_ellipse_twist_summary: Twist offset for arm ellipticity (-0.1 ~ 0.1, precise mode only)
